decisions.summary: New docstring form: About: paragraphs and a Guesses: bullet list; no feature-level Label: (None in the new form); Form: particular optional; old form parses until the last rollout task removes it
decisions.why: FR-005 makes a guess a property of a statement and the spec's Decisions table keeps the four classes per statement; FR-002 (nothing announced as accurate) holds. Removing the old form at the end serves FR-011. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: One tabbed dialog About / Guesses / References; empty tabs not drawn; the References tab replaces the separate references dialog; the place card gets the same tabs; old-form classes shown on About until rewritten
decisions.why: FR-005, FR-006, FR-007 and the GM's 'about guesses and references'. The old-form display is transitional and never lands (FR-012); FR-011 rewrites every class. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: The two guideline documents are the checks' single contract, copied into each bundle, rules numbered and findings naming their rule; GM-asked changes go there first
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-003, FR-010 and SC-001. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: Two agents: modal-form (form) and modal-research, which reports THREE verdicts (accuracy, references, gaps), each its own owed unit (modal-accuracy, modal-references, modal-gaps) and its own ledger row; particulars use the same two agents with the particular rules and the canon answer
decisions.why: FR-008 says 'Each check is a defined agent' and SC-003 'the three checks', so one agent carrying accuracy and references departs from the letter. Round 1 ruled it legitimate on condition that the three remain separately measurable; the amended D4 meets that condition exactly: three verdicts, three owed units, three ledger rows, so SC-003's 'passed the three checks, recorded in the review ledger with cost' is measured per check. Every criterion FR-008 (b) and (c) names is still checked by an agent independent of the author, owed and enforced at the push, and the GM's own words leave the packaging open ('maybe there's a subagent check specifically for deciding which research things should be linked. I'm not sure'). The purpose is untouched.

decisions.summary: Prepass and bundle; the gap candidates are the UNION of every question sharing ANY subject tag with the Entry pages and every question whose words carry the kind's name or a glossary variant; ranking orders and never cuts; modal-research may grep the whole record copy; 0004 named as the test
decisions.why: Round 1 ruled the AND-on-primary-subject filter NOT LEGITIMATE because it excluded 0004, the spec's own Context example. The amendment takes the union, forbids cutting, and lets the agent search the whole record beyond the list - which is US3 scenario 2's 'searched the record ... (by tag and by term)' and FR-008(c) without narrowing. Measured this round on the tags comment lines: 0004 carries 'subject=tiers,households', 0029 and 0028 carry 'subject=homesteads,buildings,households', so 0004 meets the union through 'households' and D7's required finding is reachable. research/assets/glossary-variants.txt exists. No longer a narrowing.

decisions.summary: modal-form and the three modal-research units owed per new-form class when About/Guesses/Entry text changes; modal-research also owed when an Entry page changes; replaces entry-drift for new-form classes; enforced by entry-gate at the push
decisions.why: FR-008: owed by a changed modal and enforced at the push 'as entry-drift is'. Precision note, not a fidelity finding: the Entry-page trigger still names a unit 'modal-research:<key>', which is no longer one of the three units D4 and D6 define; when built it should owe the three units (at least modal-accuracy), so that entry-drift's question - does the modal still agree with its pages - stays owed for new-form classes. Read either way nothing the spec asks goes unchecked.

decisions.summary: Both checks first run on the current farmhouse and garden text and must report the farmhouse's missing materials and occupancy, the garden's guess-led opening, and 0004 as a gap
decisions.why: Enforcement of FR-008 (a check proved to fire on the motivating defects); serves the request rather than adding scope. With D5's union it is now reachable.

decisions.summary: The farmhouse's standard questions answered from the record first (0029, 0028, 0004, 0048, 0030); unanswered ones get the full research pass before becoming a guess; research: physical tasks
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions (research pass before a guess), US1 scenario 1 and the research doctrine. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: Pilot hand-off: rewrite, both checks green (two rounds), regenerate Inashiro in the clone, give the GM the path; verdict in tasks.md; farmhouse then garden, a further feature only if the garden's first rewrite needs changes; rollout waits for the go-ahead
decisions.why: FR-010, FR-012, US6 and the GM's sequence. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: Title card choices (sketch, settled after the pilots): a declared choices.json listing EVERY per-settlement choice, rolled, declared or pinned, with a test holding every declared knob and every meta key a ### Features fact came from; each value a standardized modal in a new registry; ### Features facts become choices or counts; a test holds no hamlet feature modal differs between maps
decisions.why: FR-004, FR-009 ('every per-settlement choice ... each knob's value, and the per-map facts now in ### Features'), US4 and the pinned-knob edge case. Round 1's condition (every choice listed, the table only separating knobs from other meta) is now stated and enforced. Precision note, measured this round: the KNOBS registry lives in settlement/_knobs.py, but only 16 knobs are registered in that file; seven more (family_form, weir_form, fan_middle, footbridge_form, winter_crop, paddy_rest, windbreak_belt) register into it from other modules. The test must read the populated KNOBS registry, not the 16 register_knob lines of the file (the spec's Context count), or 'leaves no knob off' is not what it enforces. Non-knob per-settlement values such as harvest_weather (declared on the plan, never rolled) and hamlet_burial reach the table through the ### Features half of the test. Settling the sketch edits plan.md, which changes this digest and returns it here.

decisions.summary: Sheets after the hamlet rollout: each compound kind tagged particular (particulars.py membership, or setting-particular content even when on several sheets) or standard; each sheet's ### Features entries reviewed under the particular guidelines; canon answer in the particular bundle
decisions.why: FR-003, FR-011, US5 and the spec's edge case that reuse across sheets does not make a kind general. Unchanged from round 1.

decisions.summary: Both new agents pinned on Opus at medium effort, omitClaudeMd true
decisions.why: FR-008 asks for defined agents on pinned tiers; the tier is a cost/design matter, not fidelity.

decisions.summary: The rollout is 56 hamlet classes, the choice values and 99 sheet kinds, each with the checks; parallel writer agents on disjoint modules after the go-ahead
decisions.why: Not a narrowing: every class, value and kind is in scope (FR-011). The figure now carries its method and date; re-run this round, '^class .*(Kind)' across compound_kinds/*.py counts 99 (particulars 18, shrine 16, grounds 22, household 27, office 16).
